create_equalization_qconfig: create an EqualizationQConfig with custom input and weight observers for per-tensor and per-channel quantization
calculate_equalization_scale: calculate the equalization scale between input and weight observers to balance quantization error across layers
convert_eq_obs: convert equalization observers in a GraphModule by scaling weights and inserting mul operators before quantization nodes
get_layer_sqnr_dict: run the numeric suite on float and quantized models to compute per-layer SQNR values for equalization decisions
get_equalization_qconfig_dict: build an equalization_qconfig_dict targeting the layers with the lowest SQNR values for selective equalization
